notes.title: New update: remap keyboard and joypad input select
notes.notes:
Hi guys!
First, thank you for your support and your feedback! :16bitHeart:

:8bitfire: We have released a new update, here the features: :8bitfire:

- Now you can remap the keyboard keys.
- Now you can select the port/input of your controllers.
- Added new seep logo
- fixed some glitches and bugs.

Thank you to playing Abduction Bit, we want improve our work to make a good experiece for all users! Thanks! :8bitgrey:
